SELECT TRANS_PARAM_NO, APPLY_TYPE, ESS.ACTIVITY, SG.CONTENT AS APPLY_NAME, TO_CHAR(ESS.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE, ESS.CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(ESS.UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATE_DATE, ESS.UPDATED_BY, ESS.DUTY_NO, SG2.CONTENT DUTY_NAME FROM HR_TRANS_PARAM ESS, SY_CODE SY, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG2 WHERE ESS.APPLY_TYPE = SY.CODE_NO(+) AND ESS.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) =#interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND SG2.LANGUAGE(+) =#interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND SG.NO(+) = SY.CODE_NO AND SG2.NO(+)=ESS.DUTY_NO
APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#
TRANS_PARAM_NO = #TRANS_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#
ORDER BY APPLY_TYPE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_TRANS_PARAM ESS, SY_CODE SY, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE SG.NO(+) = SY.CODE_NO AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND ESS.APPLY_TYPE = SY.CODE_NO(+) AND ESS.CPNY_ID=#interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
APPLY_TYPE = #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#
TRANS_PARAM_NO = #TRANS_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#
ORDER BY APPLY_TYPE

SELECT A.CODE_NO AS CODE_NO, S.CONTENT AS CODENAME FROM SY_CODE A, SY_CODE_PARAM SC, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S WHERE EXISTS (SELECT C.CODE_NO FROM SY_CODE C, SY_CODE_PARAM P WHERE C.PARENT_CODE_NO = 1358 AND C.CODE_NO = P.CODE_NO AND P.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND C.ACTIVITY=1 AND C.CODE_NO = A.PARENT_CODE_NO) AND A.CODE_NO = S.NO(+) AND S.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND SC.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.CODE_NO = SC.CODE_NO AND A.ACTIVITY=1 ORDER BY A.PARENT_CODE_NO,A.ORDERNO

SELECT A.CODE_NO AS CODE_NO, S.CONTENT AS CODENAME FROM SY_CODE A, SY_CODE_PARAM SC, SY_GLOBAL_NAME S WHERE A.CODE_NO = S.NO(+) AND S.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND SC.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND A.CODE_NO = SC.CODE_NO AND A.CODE_NO NOT IN (31,21,218107) AND A.PARENT_CODE_NO = 16413 AND A.ACTIVITY=1 ORDER BY A.PARENT_CODE_NO,A.ORDERNO
SELECT T.DUTY_NO,SG.CONTENT DUTYNAME FROM HR_DUTY T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG WHERE T.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND CPNY_ID =#interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY=1

SELECT distinct (S.DUTY_NO) DUTY_NO, SG.CONTENT AS POSTNAME, S.Orderno FROM SY_AFFIRMOR_LIST S, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SG, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE S.DUTY_NO = SG.NO(+) AND SG.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND S.DEPT_NO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND S.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# ORDER BY S.Orderno
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO HR_TRANS_PARAM ( TRANS_PARAM_NO, APPLY_TYPE, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, DEPTNO, CPNY_ID, DUTY_NO ) VALUES ( #TRANS_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#, #APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#, 1, SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #serchDept:VARCHAR#, #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#, #DUTY_NO:VARCHAR# )

INSERT INTO HR_TRANS_AFFIRM_PARAM ( TRANS_AFFIRM_PARAM_NO, TRANS_PARAM_NO, AFFIRM_LEVEL, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CPNY_ID, DUTY_NO ) VALUES ( HR_TRANS_AFFIRM_PARAM_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #TRANS_PARAM_NO:NUMERIC#, #AFFIRM_LEVEL:VARCHAR#, 1, SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#, #DUTY_NO:VARCHAR# )
sqlMap.update: UPDATE HR_TRANS_PARAM SET APPLY_TYPE=#APPLY_TYPE:VARCHAR#, UPDATE_DATE=SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY=#UPDATED_BY:VARCHAR# WHERE TRANS_PARAM_NO=#TRANS_PARAM_NO:VARCHAR#

A.TRANS_PARAM_NO = #TRANS_PARAM_NO:VARCHAR#
